{
  "strategy": "Switch the ranking generator off the axis-aligned-tree axis entirely: fit an MLP (neural family) on median-imputed, standardised features — the first non-tree, non-linear ranking this run has produced. The two gbdt attempts pinned balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut at 0.7851–0.7922 (roc_auc 0.8572–0.8598) and cut_headroom is down to 0.0266, so the remaining 0.1297 is in the ranking, not the cut. A 2-layer MLP (128, 64) with alpha=3e-4, learning_rate_init=3e-4, batch_size=128, max_iter=400 and early_stopping=true sees the 61 numeric + 180 one-hot columns as a smooth function of scaled inputs and can combine the many 'moderate' correlates (attractive_o<path>, funny, shared_interests, guess_prob_liked) with the one strong correlate (like) multiplicatively rather than through step splits. Preprocessing changes with the family: impute=median + scale=true (mandatory for a neural net; impute=none is gbdt<path> only), plus missing_count as one extra column so the model retains the aggregate 'how many fields this row left unmeasured' signal that median filling erases — the card shows 60 columns with missing values, one at 0.785, so that count is real information a scaled imputed matrix otherwise loses. missing_indicator is left off: it would add 119 near-duplicate columns to a net that has no NaN branch to make them cheap, and its value under imputation is explicitly not established. Because sklearn's MLP has no class_weight, the operating point stays at the default 0.5 cut on imbalanced data; that is deliberate this attempt — the diagnostics I need are roc_auc, pr_auc and balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut, which are cut-free. Decision rule for attempt 4: if balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut clears 0.7922 the neural ranking is better than every tree ranking and attempt 4 tunes capacity there; if it lands inside 0.7851–0.7922 the run has now shown three independent ranking generators sharing one ceiling and attempt 4 should record that the 0.8882 bar is unreachable on these columns, reporting the best achievable operating point instead.",

    "early_stopping": true
  },

    "missing_indicator": false,
    "missing_count": true
  },
  "changes_from_last": "Different model family (neural mlp, not gbdt<path> — the first non-tree ranking of the run) and a preprocessing pipeline no previous attempt used: impute=median + scale=true instead of impute=none<path>=false, with missing_count=true adding one aggregate missingness column. No boosting hyperparameters, no class_weight<path> lever (mlp has none), so this row's roc_auc / pr_auc / balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut are a clean read on the ranking axis against the gbdt pair 0.8572–0.8598 / 0.5787–0.6049 / 0.7851–0.7922.",
  "rationale": "The critic's verdict is wrong_model_family with the arithmetic behind it: cut_headroom 0.0266 is only 20% of the 0.1297 shortfall, and the required KS is 0.7764 against 0.5844 measured, so no further point in gbdt hyperparameter space and no weight move can reach the bar — the ranking generator must change. Both attempts so far were axis-aligned gradient-boosted trees on NaN-split raw columns, i.e. one family in effect; mlp is the highest-capacity available alternative and the only one that forms smooth combinations of the 61 scaled numeric columns instead of step functions, which is the plausible source of a ranking above the tree ceiling on survey-rating data where several moderate correlates are known to combine (attractiveness<path> ratings and like). Capacity is set to fit 5,026 rows without repeating iteration 1's memorisation: two modest layers, alpha 3e-4, small init learning rate, and early_stopping=true which costs ~503 training rows but is the only overfit guard mlp has here (the run has 600 s and prior attempts used 12 s, so cost is not a constraint). missing_count is included because median imputation flattens the 60 partially-missing columns — one missing in 78.5% of rows — and the count is the one missingness summary a dense imputed matrix cannot express; missing_indicator is excluded to avoid 119 extra columns of unestablished value on a net that is sensitive to input dimensionality. If this ranking also lands inside 0.7851–0.7922, that is decisive evidence about the bar rather than about the tuning.",
